findings.text: In the 01_6 'coming up' panel, the middle preview is meant to be 'a loop with an arrow turning around zero' (the_bump.rs previews(): Arrow from 0 to polar(0.8, 0.9)). On screen there is only a detached white arrow tip, about 8 px wide at 960x540, floating inside the circle at about 0.4 of the radius, with no shaft and nothing touching the circle or the centre (crops/s0023-slot4-preview3x.png). It does not read as an arrow from zero. Probable cause: at the pinned franken_manim a399d626, Arrow::new trims buff = MED_SMALL_BUFF (0.25) at both ends (fmn-library line.rs:494, 619-626). The arrow is about 0.5 units long (circle radius 34 px at 960x540), so the shaft is trimmed to nothing. A buff(0.0) or Vector-style arrow would draw it. On screen from about 93.2 s to the 01_6 fade-out (sheets 23-25 and later); first sampled frame f5591.
